owner_posts.post_text: Minimally invasive bypass surgery
Coverage on our Robotic cardiac surgery program.

Some moments in medical practice go beyond clinical success—and this is one of them. This photograph captures a heartfelt gesture where a patient’s son chose to pin his mother’s post-operative picture on my OPD board as a token of gratitude.

His mother underwent cardiac surgery under my care and recovered well, but what truly stands out is the family’s appreciation and trust. For a son to publicly express his thanks in such a personal way is deeply humbling and reminds me why I chose this profession.

Every surgery is not just a procedure—it is a responsibility towards a family’s hopes and emotions. Outcomes matter, but so does the journey: clear communication, compassionate care, and unwavering commitment.

Gestures like these inspire me to continue striving for excellence and reinforce the belief that good medicine is built on both skill and human connection.

Grateful for the trust my patients and their families place in me every day.

This image represents a truly special milestone—an 82-year-old patient who recently underwent successful cardiac surgery under my care. It stands as a powerful reminder that age alone is not a limitation when it comes to offering safe and effective heart treatment.

Managing cardiac conditions in elderly patients requires a highly individualized approach, meticulous planning, and careful execution. With advances in surgical techniques, anesthesia, and perioperative care, we are now able to achieve excellent outcomes even in high-risk age groups.

In this case, every step—from preoperative assessment to postoperative recovery—was tailored to ensure maximum safety and comfort. The patient recovered smoothly, with stable vitals and encouraging early mobility, reinforcing the fact that well-selected elderly patients can benefit greatly from timely surgical intervention.

This journey reflects not just medical progress, but also the importance of trust, teamwork, and patient resilience. It is always deeply rewarding to see elderly patients regain their strength and return to their families with renewed quality of life.

Age should never be the sole deciding factor—right care at the right time can make all the difference.

I am honored to share that my recent work in robotic cardiac surgery has been featured in a leading national newspaper. This recognition highlights the growing role of advanced technology in transforming heart surgery and improving patient outcomes.

Robotic cardiac surgery allows us to perform complex procedures through small incisions with exceptional precision and control. Compared to traditional open-heart surgery, patients benefit from less pain, minimal scarring, shorter hospital stays, and faster recovery.

In my practice, I have been applying robotic techniques for coronary bypass and valve procedures, focusing on safety, accuracy, and patient-centered care. Careful patient selection and a well-coordinated team are key to achieving the best results.

This feature aims to spread awareness that modern cardiac surgery is evolving rapidly, and many patients today have access to less invasive options. My goal remains to provide the highest quality care while embracing innovations that enhance recovery and quality of life.

Grateful to my patients and team for their trust and support.
ROBOT ASSISTED CABG in progress
Minimally-Invasive CABG in obese patients (140 kg)

featured_reviews.name: Amardeep Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. C K Ponde at Hinduja Hospital is truly a God-sent doctor for our family. The way he took care of my dad, right from the ICU to the ward, was exceptional and beyond words. During one of the most stressful phases of our lives, he stayed calm, patient, and reassuring, which gave us so much confidence n strength.
What makes him stand out even more is his honesty and clarity. Every other doctor we consulted at Apollo Hospital in Belapur suggested that my dad immediately undergo angioplasty followd by angiography or even bypass surgery. It was overwhelming n created a lot of panic for us. Bt Dr. Ponde was the only 1 who didn’t rush us or scare us. He carefully evaluated the situation n assured us that there was no need to undergo all of this at the moment. His approach was thoughtful, balanced, n truly patient-first.
Even after discharge, his care continued. When we went for a follow-up after one month, he remembered my dad and even remembered his ICU bed number. That personal touch really says a lot abt how involved n dedicated he is. He patiently answered all our questions and guided us without ever making us feel rushed.
Dr. C K Ponde is not just an outstanding cardiologist but also an incredibly kind, compassionate, and humble human being. We genuinely felt we were in the safest hands throughout. He is our safe zone now. Forever grateful to him and would highly, highly recommend him to anyone looking for honest and compassionate cardiac care. Thank you for taking so good care of my Dad 🙏🏻
From the daughter you remembered from day one till today 🙏.
